## 11) BEHAVIOUR AND DEVELOPMENT
a) How this affects the patient: The patient has developmental delays and shorter fingers than usual.
b) How this affects others with the syndrome: People with KBG syndrome often have developmental delays, behavioral differences, and learning difficulties.

## 12) SKELETAL
a) How this affects the patient: The patient has shorter fingers than usual.
b) How this affects others with the syndrome: Some people with KBG syndrome have skeletal anomalies, including an unusual structure of their spinal bones, short fingers, and hip dysplasia.
